create or alter function [metrics].[GetGovernanceScore] ( @assetUid uniqueidentifier, @effectiveDate date ) returns --declare @measures table ( ParentVersionUid uniqueidentifier, VersionUid uniqueidentifier, [Value] decimal(8,6), [Weight] decimal(8,6), MatchUid uniqueidentifier, OtherMatches nvarchar(max) ) as begin declare @initial table( AssetId bigint, ParentUid uniqueidentifier, AssetUid uniqueidentifier, [Name] nvarchar(250), EffectiveDate datetime, EffectiveEndDate datetime, [Weight] float, Threshold float, MatchConditionsOnly bit, [Check] varchar(25), [External] nvarchar(max), [Field] nvarchar(max), [Owner] nvarchar(max), [Predicate] nvarchar(max), [Relation] nvarchar(max), [Uid] uniqueidentifier, Conditions nvarchar(max) );
insert into @initial select v.AssetId, v.ParentUid, v.AssetUid, v.Name, v.EffectiveDate, v.EffectiveEndDate, v.Weight, v.Threshold, v.MatchConditionsOnly, v.[Check], v.[External], v.[Field], v.[Owner], v.[Predicate], v.[Relation], v.Uid, metrics.BuildConditionJson(v.Uid) as Conditions from ( select row_number() over(partition by sv.AssetUid order by sv.EffectiveDate desc) as RowNum, sv.*, svd.*, p.Uid as ParentUid, a.Id as AssetId from metrics.AssetVersion sv cross apply openjson(sv.Definition) with ( [Check] varchar(25) '$.Governance.Check', [External] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.External' as json, [Field] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.Field' as json, [Owner] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.Owner' as json, [Predicate] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.Predicate' as json, [Relation] nvarchar(max) '$.Governance.Relation' as json ) svd inner join metrics.Asset sa on sa.Uid = sv.AssetUid inner join metrics.Allocation sd on sd.Uid = sa.AllocationUid and sd.ScoreType = 1 inner join dbo.AssetType t on t.Uid = sd.AssetTypeUid inner join dbo.Asset a on a.Uid = @assetUid and a.AssetTypeID = t.Id outer apply ( select pv.Uid from metrics.Asset pa inner join metrics.AssetVersion pv on pv.AssetUid = pa.Uid and pa.Uid = sa.ParentUid and pv.EffectiveDate <= @effectiveDate and (pv.EffectiveEndDate is null or pv.EffectiveEndDate >= @effectiveDate) ) p where sv.EffectiveDate <= @effectiveDate and (sv.EffectiveEndDate is null or sv.EffectiveEndDate >= @effectiveDate) ) v where v.RowNum = 1 order by v.ParentUid, v.Name, v.EffectiveDate
-- Process conditions and load new table --------------------- declare @tbl table( AssetId bigint, ParentUid uniqueidentifier, AssetUid uniqueidentifier, [Name] nvarchar(250), EffectiveDate datetime, EffectiveEndDate datetime, [Weight] float, Threshold float, MatchConditionsOnly bit, [Check] varchar(25), [External] nvarchar(max), [Field] nvarchar(max), [Owner] nvarchar(max), [Predicate] nvarchar(max), [Relation] nvarchar(max), [Uid] uniqueidentifier, Conditions nvarchar(max), MatchUid uniqueidentifier, OtherMatches nvarchar(max),
AssetTypeId int, -- save on requerying the same tables. FieldTypeId int, -- save on requerying the same tables. [FieldType] varchar(25), -- The data type of the field. LookupObject varchar(50), -- In case this is a field compairon for a Lookup field, LookupObjectId int, Operator varchar(50), -- get the operator SingleValue nvarchar(max), -- for single value compairson StartRangeValue nvarchar(max), -- for range comparison EndRangeValue nvarchar(max), -- for range comparisons ListValues nvarchar(max), -- when comparing multiple values. --FieldValue nvarchar(max), --temp, purely for testing Value decimal(8,6) -- The final measure value. );
insert into @tbl (AssetId, AssetTypeId, ParentUid, AssetUid, [Name], EffectiveDate, EffectiveEndDate, [Weight], Threshold, MatchConditionsOnly, [Check], [External], [Field], [Owner], [Predicate], [Relation], [Uid], Conditions, MatchUid, OtherMatches) select m.AssetId, a.AssetTypeId, m.ParentUid, m.AssetUid, m.[Name], m.EffectiveDate, m.EffectiveEndDate, coalesce(cm.[Weight], m.[Weight]), coalesce(cm.Threshold, m.Threshold), m.MatchConditionsOnly, m.[Check], m.[External], m.[Field], m.[Owner], m.[Predicate], m.[Relation], m.[Uid], m.Conditions, cm.MatchUid, cm.OtherMatches from @initial m inner join dbo.Asset a on a.ID = m.AssetId cross apply metrics.ConditionsFiltering(m.AssetId, m.Conditions, m.MatchConditionsOnly) cm where cm.[Include] = 1
-- Parse the values to validate for testing. update m set m.SingleValue = sV.SingleValue, m.StartRangeValue = rV.StartRangeValue, m.EndRangeValue = rV.EndRangeValue, m.ListValues = mV.[Values], m.AssetTypeId = a.AssetTypeID, m.FieldTypeId = ft.ID, m.FieldType = ft.[Type], m.Operator = c.Operator, m.LookupObject = ft.LookupObjectType + 'Type', m.LookupObjectId = ft.LookupObjectId --,m.FieldValue = f.FormattedValue from @tbl m cross apply openjson(Field) with (FieldTypeName nvarchar(250), [Operator] varchar(25), [Values] nvarchar(max) as json) c inner join dbo.Asset a on a.ID = m.AssetId inner join dbo.FieldType ft on ft.AssetTypeID = a.AssetTypeID and ft.Name = c.FieldTypeName left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = ft.ID cross apply ( select case when c.Operator = 'Between' then case when ft.Type = 'Date' then (select min([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] date '$')) when ft.Type = 'DateTime' then (select min([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] datetime '$')) when ft.Type = 'Decimal' then (select min([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] decimal '$')) when ft.Type = 'Number' then (select min([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] bigint '$')) end else null end as StartRangeValue, case when c.Operator = 'Between' then case when ft.Type = 'Date' then (select max([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] date '$')) when ft.Type = 'DateTime' then (select max([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] datetime '$')) when ft.Type = 'Decimal' then (select max([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] decimal '$')) when ft.Type = 'Number' then (select max([Value]) from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] bigint '$')) end else null end as EndRangeValue ) rV cross apply ( select case when c.Operator in ('Between', 'In', 'NotIn') then null else (select top 1 [Value] from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max) '$')) end as SingleValue ) sV cross apply ( select case when c.Operator in ('In', 'NotIn') then ( select [Value] from openjson(c.[Values]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max) '$') for json path ) else null end as [Values] ) mV where m.[Check] = 'Field'
-- Now process each Governance check -------------------------
-- External measure check. update m set m.[Value] = iif(r.[Value] = 1, 1, 0) from @tbl m inner join dbo.Asset a on a.Id = m.AssetId inner join metrics.ExternalMeasureResult r on r.AssetUid = a.[Uid] and r.AssetVersionUid = m.Uid and r.EffectiveDate = @effectiveDate where m.[Check] = 'External';
-- Non-lookups, checking Populated/NotPopulated update m set m.[Value] = case when m.Operator = 'Populated' and (f.FormattedValue is not null and f.FormattedValue <> '') then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotPopulated' and (f.FormattedValue is null or f.FormattedValue = '') then 1 else 0 end from @tbl m inner join dbo.Asset a on a.ID = m.AssetId left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType <> 'Lookup' and m.Operator in ('Populated', 'NotPopulated')
-- Non-lookups, skipping Populated/NotPopulated update m set m.[Value] = case when m.FieldType = 'Boolean' then case when m.Operator = 'IsTrue' and lower(f.FormattedValue) in ('true', '1') then 1 when m.Operator = 'IsFalse' and lower(f.FormattedValue) in ('false', '0') then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'Date' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as date) = try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as date) <> try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator = 'Between' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as date) between try_parse(m.StartRangeValue as date) and try_parse(m.EndRangeValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator in ('After', 'GreaterThan') and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as date) > try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator in ('OnOrAfter', 'GreaterThanOrEquals') and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as date) >= try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator in ('Before', 'LessThan') and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as date) < try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 when m.Operator in ('OnOrBefore', 'LessThanOrEquals') and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as date) <= try_parse(m.SingleValue as date) then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'DateTime' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as datetime) = try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as datetime) <> try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator = 'Between' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as datetime) between try_parse(m.StartRangeValue as datetime) and try_parse(m.EndRangeValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator in ('After', 'GreaterThan') and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as datetime) > try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator in ('OnOrAfter', 'GreaterThanOrEquals') and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as datetime) >= try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator in ('Before', 'LessThan') and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as datetime) < try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 when m.Operator in ('OnOrBefore', 'LessThanOrEquals') and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as datetime) <= try_parse(m.SingleValue as datetime) then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'Decimal' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as decimal) = try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as decimal) <> try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'Between' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as decimal) between try_parse(m.StartRangeValue as decimal) and try_parse(m.EndRangeValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'GreaterThan' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as decimal) > try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'GreaterThanOrEquals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as decimal) >= try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'LessThan' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as decimal) < try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 when m.Operator = 'LessThanOrEquals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as decimal) <= try_parse(m.SingleValue as decimal) then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'Number' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as bigint) = try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as bigint) <> try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 when m.Operator = 'Between' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as bigint) between try_parse(m.StartRangeValue as bigint) and try_parse(m.EndRangeValue as bigint) then 1 when m.Operator = 'GreaterThan' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as bigint) > try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 when m.Operator = 'GreaterThanOrEquals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as bigint) >= try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint)then 1 when m.Operator = 'LessThan' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as bigint) < try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint)then 1 when m.Operator = 'LessThanOrEquals' and try_parse(f.FormattedValue as bigint) <= try_parse(m.SingleValue as bigint) then 1 else 0 end
when m.FieldType = 'Text' then case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and f.FormattedValue = m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and f.FormattedValue <> m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'Contains' and f.FormattedValue like '%' + m.SingleValue + '%' then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotContains' and f.FormattedValue not like '%' + m.SingleValue + '%' then 1 when m.Operator = 'StartsWith' and f.FormattedValue like m.SingleValue + '%' then 1 when m.Operator = 'EndsWith' and f.FormattedValue like '%' + m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'In' and f.FormattedValue in ( select v.[Value] from openjson(m.[ListValues]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotIn' and f.FormattedValue not in ( select v.[Value] from openjson(m.[ListValues]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 else 0 end
else 0 end from @tbl m inner join dbo.Asset a on a.ID = m.AssetId left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType <> 'Lookup' and m.Value is null and m.Operator not in ('Populated', 'NotPopulated')
-- Perform Lookup Populated check update m set m.[Value] = iif(f.ID is not null and a.Present = 1, 1, 0) -- we are not validating the specific value - just that the field value is not null and it does point to a valid asset. from @tbl m left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId outer apply ( select 1 as Present from dbo.AssetType lt inner join dbo.Asset la on la.AssetTypeID = lt.ID and lt.Object = m.LookupObject and lt.ObjectID = m.LookupObjectId and la.ObjectID = try_parse(f.Value as int) ) a where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator = 'Populated'
---- Perform Lookup NotPopulated check update m set m.[Value] = iif(f.ID is null and a.Present is null, 1, 0) from @tbl m left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId outer apply ( select 1 as Present from dbo.AssetType lt inner join dbo.Asset la on la.AssetTypeID = lt.ID and lt.Object = m.LookupObject and lt.ObjectID = m.LookupObjectId and la.ObjectID = try_parse(f.Value as int) ) a where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator = 'NotPopulated'
-- Perform Lookup other check update m set m.[Value] = iif(a.Present = 1, 1, 0) from @tbl m left join dbo.Field f on f.AssetID = m.AssetId and f.FieldTypeID = m.FieldTypeId outer apply ( select 1 as Present from dbo.AssetType lt inner join dbo.Asset la on la.AssetTypeID = lt.ID and lt.Object = m.LookupObject and lt.ObjectID = m.LookupObjectId and la.ObjectID = try_parse(f.Value as int) and case when m.Operator = 'Equals' and la.Uid = m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotEquals' and la.Uid <> m.SingleValue then 1 when m.Operator = 'In' and la.Uid in ( select v.[Value] from openjson(m.[ListValues]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 when m.Operator = 'NotIn' and la.Uid not in ( select v.[Value] from openjson(m.[ListValues]) with ([Value] nvarchar(max)) v ) then 1 else 0 end = 1 ) a where m.[Check] = 'Field' and m.FieldType = 'Lookup' and m.[Value] is null and m.Operator not in ('Populated', 'NotPopulated')
-- OWNERSHIP -----------------------------------------------
declare @ResData table( ResponsibilityTypeID int, AssetID bigint, AssetTypeID int, ApplyToType bit, Present int, index cx_resdata clustered(ResponsibilityTypeID,AssetID,AssetTypeID) );
With rs as (select distinct AssetTypeId from @tbl) insert into @ResData select distinct rd.ResponsibilityTypeID,rd.AssetID,rd.AssetTypeID,rd.ApplyToType,1 Present from rs cross apply ResponsibilityDetailByAssetTypeID(rs.AssetTypeID) rd;
update m set m.[Value] = case when c.Operator = 'Populated' and o.Present = 1 and rt.ID is not null then 1 when c.Operator = 'NotPopulated' and (o.Present is null or rt.ID is null) then 1 else 0 end from @tbl m cross apply openjson([Owner]) with (ResponsibilityTypeUid uniqueidentifier, [Operator] varchar(25)) c left join dbo.ResponsibilityType rt on rt.Uid = c.ResponsibilityTypeUid left join @ResData o on o.ResponsibilityTypeID = rt.ID and (o.AssetID = m.AssetId or (o.AssetID = 0 and o.AssetTypeID = m.AssetTypeId and o.ApplyToType = 1)) where m.[Check] = 'Owner'
-- PREDICATE ----------------------------------------------- update m set m.[Value] = case when c.Operator = 'Populated' and o.Present = 1 then 1 when c.Operator = 'NotPopulated' and o.Present is null then 1 else 0 end from @tbl m cross apply openjson([Predicate]) with (PredicateUid uniqueidentifier, [Operator] varchar(25)) c outer apply ( select 1 as Present from [dbo].[PredicateIntersect] where [PredicateUid] = c.PredicateUid and (SubjectAssetID = m.AssetId or ObjectAssetID = m.AssetId) ) o where m.[Check] = 'Predicate'
-- RELATION ------------------------------------------------ update m set m.[Value] = case when c.Operator = 'Populated' and o.Present = 1 then 1 when c.Operator = 'NotPopulated' and o.Present is null then 1 else 0 end from @tbl m cross apply openjson([Relation]) with (IntersectTypeUid uniqueidentifier, [Operator] varchar(25)) c outer apply ( select 1 as Present from [dbo].[PredicateIntersect] where IntersectTypeUid = c.IntersectTypeUid and (SubjectAssetID = m.AssetId or ObjectAssetID = m.AssetId) ) o where m.[Check] = 'Relation'
insert into @measures (ParentVersionUid, VersionUid, Value, Weight, MatchUid, OtherMatches) select ParentUid, Uid, [Value], Weight, MatchUid, OtherMatches from @tbl;
--select * from @measures return; end
